4:["$","p",null,{"children":["This is directly relevant to Bitcoin. Since the Taproot upgrade (2021), Bitcoin natively supports Schnorr signatures (",["$","a",null,{"target":"_blank","rel":"noopener noreferrer","href":"https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0340.mediawiki","children":"BIP-340"}],") for transaction authorization. FROST produces standard Schnorr signatures on the secp256k1 curve — exactly what Bitcoin expects. This makes FROST a natural fit for threshold signing of Bitcoin transactions: custody solutions, cross-chain bridges, or any setup where multiple parties must approve a spend, without revealing on-chain that a threshold scheme was used at all."]}]
